decision_witness_split.rule: An exact SAT terminal residual yields SAT in DECISION_CORE without requiring local reconstruction of a root assignment.
decision_witness_split.why_sound_for_P_vs_NP: The theorem target is the SAT decision problem. If this fixed decision core is universally polynomial and total, a satisfying assignment is recoverable by standard polynomial self-reduction using the decider.

input_bit_complexity_firewall.rule: Sorted source variables are densely relabeled to 1..n before internal N and caps are frozen; original identifier bit lengths are charged in source_binary_units.

partial_decider_claim.statement: With deterministic comparison-based data structures and the frozen C=2,k=1,width=3 grammar, every individual run terminates in polynomial work with one of SAT, UNSAT, OPEN. A conservative previously frozen bound is O(N^13) bit operations; this exponent is intentionally loose and not a claim of optimized complexity.
partial_decider_claim.not_yet_a_P_algorithm: OPEN is still an admitted output.

central_unproved_lemma.formal_target: For every densely normalized CNF phi and every nonterminal state S reachable by PIRC_DECISION_CORE_V0_3 under the original root input budget N, at least one frozen exact terminal lane or frozen exact strict-progress transition is available before the resource caps are exhausted.
central_unproved_lemma.equivalent: PIRC_DECISION_CORE_V0_3 never returns OPEN on any CNF.

conditional_theorem.statement: If REACHABLE_MOVE_OR_TERMINAL_TOTALITY is proved for this exact frozen machine, then the already-bounded partial decider becomes a polynomial-time total SAT decider; therefore SAT is in P and P=NP.

finite_evidence_only.meaning: Hostile bounded evidence against easy counterexamples only; not universal proof.

next_proof_task.proof_direction: Derive structural conditions forced by the failure of all earlier exact lanes, then prove that those conditions imply existence of either a capped pivot, a v2 root-restoring OR-pair, or a v3 extension-tail pair; otherwise freeze the first exact counterexample.
next_proof_task.counterexample_direction: Search only under this frozen v0.3 grammar. A found OPEN refutes this machine's totality but not P=NP itself.
